name: EPL Limited
summary: EPL Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells plastic packaging materials in the Americas, Europe, Africa, the Middle East, South Asia, and East Asia Pacific. It offers dispensing systems, caps and closures, laminated tubes, laminates, and extruded tubes. The company also provides laminated tubes, including Platina, Platina Pro, r-Platina, Platina Me, Platina Vision, Platina Plus, Etain, Super Titanium, and Clarion, as well as Organic Green Maple Leaf and Green Maple Leaf. In addition, it offers printing technologies, such as NEOSeam, glitter, glow in the dark, 3D foil, screen braille effect, and lens foil effect.
